## Summary

The root cause of the encoding-related test failures was that 33 Python encoding module files in `/opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/python3.10/encodings/` had been renamed with a `.corrupted` suffix (e.g., `utf_16_le.py.corrupted`, `windows-1251.py.corrupted`, `gb18030.py.corrupted`, etc.). This prevented Python's codec registry from finding these encodings, resulting in `LookupError: unknown encoding` errors.

The fix was to rename all the corrupted files back to their original names by removing the `.corrupted` suffix:

```bash
cd /opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/python3.10/encodings/ && for f in *.corrupted; do mv "$f" "${f%.corrupted}"; done
```

All three failing tests now pass, and all 418 tests in the affected test files pass successfully.
